title: Moses Mendelssohn's Pentateuch – translation and Biur (Vienna 1795; Dessau 1815)
description: Transcription of Moses Mendelssohn's German translation of the Pentateuch and the Hebrew commentary Biur: the Biur (Sefer Netivot ha-Shalom, Vienna 1795; 4,126 verses with comment, by Mendelssohn, Solomon Dubno, Naphtali Herz Wessely, Aaron Jaroslaw and Herz Homberg), the translation in Hebrew letters (Taitsch, Vienna 1795; 5,847 verses), the translation in Latin script (Die fünf Bücher Mose, Dessau 1815; 5,846 verses), and a word-by-word alignment of the Dessau text with the Hebrew (Westminster Leningrad Codex; 81,190 segments), with review and correction lists. Structured JSON by verse. Transcribed with Claude (Anthropic, 2026) from page images in eScriptorium; a working transcription, not a critical edition. Prepared for the Safran library (https://github.com/mitkin89/Safran).
